owner_priority: Find, install and visibly verify correctly credited general species photographs before anatomy arrows, scoring-admission gates or BONAP county nativity.
methods: Checked current GitHub main hays-candidates.json to avoid duplicate candidate gallery refs for this exact batch; 3 species have no configured ref and Carolina foxtail has one.

For each exact candidate file, visited its Wikimedia Commons File: page, identified named photographer/credit and license statement. No generic category-level license substituted for exact photo-level rights.

License status documents only source usage rights as stated; final image pixel inspection and botanical name credibility remains mandatory before publishing. Especially compare annual Barnyardgrass lookalikes, compressed Rostraria, and proso millet cultivar forms.
No source photo bytes were downloaded or uploaded, no gallery files edited, no rights credit overwritten, no local Hays specimen was claimed verified.

A general reference photograph need not itself be a fully diagnosed Hays county individual. It must depict the correct species with credible source, honest nonlocal context and readable captions; keep field-key scored gate separate.
DO NOT use the additional USDA 1950 botanical illustrations to count general photographs; they are supplemental anatomical drawings only.

Before photo owner publishes, compare source file hashes/URLs against all prior image manifests and live site, verify exact photo ID/visible structures, then install eligible images to family repo with photographer, source and license, finally load public Pages and verify actual displayed pixels.
